notes: Precompiles the temporary Vite build workspace with Vite's own Oxc transformer so CRA-era JSX inside src .js files is normalized before the Vite 8/Rolldown Linux parser runs.

Keeps real source files, filenames, imports, Firebase configuration, and application behavior unchanged while preserving the existing asset-manifest build contract and cleaning the temporary build workspace after every build.
